english.title: Fail to comply with requirement / condition in notice etc. issued / granted under Tuberculosis (Wales) Order 2010
english.standardoffencewording:

english.legislation: Contrary to Article 23(5) of the Tuberculosis (Wales) Order 2010 and sections 73 and 75 of the Animal Health Act 1981.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
